notes.title: Update #2 Incoming!
notes.content:
So I've updated Infinity Saga! That's the good news!
I fixed the sound option for you all complaining about it. You now have a volume control option in the Menu Settings!

Now for the bad news :(.
Since I had to go into the main script and edit it, the older save files have been corrupted. That means if you were really far along in the game your saves before this update will not work. I'm sorry and I apologize for any inconvenience, but at least now you can adjust the music and sounds so that they don't make your ears bleed when you have headphones on.

I'm thinking about compensating you all for the slight inconvenience, so in the next update, I'll give you all something extra!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Infinity Saga will be updated today, fixing a small bug issue after the first boss battle!

Also, for you who are experiencing a flicker effect when going to full screen, that is something to do with how your nvidia graphics card works. In order to fix this problem. Go to where Infinity Saga is installed. 

Steam > steamapps > common > Infinity Saga

There should be a red icon (looks like a dragon head) that say's "Game"
Right click on it and click "Run with Graphics Processor" And select "Intergrated Graphics"

This should fix the flickering. As a side not, you can go into the Nvidia control panel and set the game to open with intergrated graphic's card as well.
